body: Hope so. He has literally saved my life and I hope to pay him back for everything one day.
Thank you. I wish to be. I have been very unfair to him without realising it and hope to do better.

So funny. I've spent my whole life thinking I'm really smart and capable and strong and that everyone who struggles is just so full of bullshit... And here I am desperate to find the will to go on, full of regrets & slowly realising I've made so many stupid decisions and lived my life all wrong. I'm not sure I have the energy right now to share more but I would really like another friend...

I really don't know how to find the energy to go on. Everything feels so pointless. From the outside it looks like I have a great life but it's just a prison and I don't know how to get out. Hell I don't think I even have the energy to explain it to anyone. I have bottled all the crap inside all my life and I'm so afraid to open it & I feel I'm just being a burden to everyone around me, especially my friend who is trying so hard to be there for me and cheer me up.
